Metadata.title: RateThatJob – Know before you go
Metadata.description: Verified reviews from people who actually worked there. Pay, hours, managers and how workplaces treat applicants.

Home.headline: Know before you go.
Home.intro: Verified reviews from people who actually worked there.
Home.introMore: Pay, hours, managers and how they treat applicants, for every workplace.
